sources.text:
Rokua Geopark is Finland's first UNESCO Global Geopark. Visit us and take a journey through landscapes shaped by the Ice Age! Rokua UNESCO Global Geopark - Rokua Geopark Rokua Geopark See and experience Learn Services Articles FI EN NL DE search See and experience Routes Cultural attractions Nature attractions Activities Environmental Art Services Accommodation Event and activity services Equipment rental Restaurants Groups Search for services Articles Pet-friendly services Educational Travel and Study Trips at Rokua UNESCO Global Geopark Humanpolis Responsibility Investing and working in the Rokua Geopark area Services for entrepreneurs For Professionals Contact Learn Stories Hiking information service of Finnish forest administration (Metsähallitus) for Rokua National Park and Manamansalo Hiking Area luontoon.fi Contact Finnish Geoparks Pohjola Route Humanpolis Oy Valtatie 17 91500 Muhos, Finland info@rokuageopark.fi Facebook Instagram YouTube Rokua Geopark Welcome to discover the traces of the last Ice Age With its charming nature trails and unique geology, Rokua Geopark is Finland's first UNESCO Global Geopark. Take a journey through landscapes shaped by the Ice Age and discover sites that tell the story of the region's origins from the Ice Age to the present day! Find your trip Arrival Geopark in the middle of Finland Rokua Geopark is located in Northern Ostrobothnia in the municipalities of Muhos, Utajärvi and Vaala. Coming from Oulu, the area begins in Muhos, about 20 km from the city, and continues to Lake Oulujärvi, about 90 km away. You can get to Rokua by public transport, car, bicycle, hiking or even by boat! Directions to Rokua Geopark THE STORY Finland’s first UNESCO Global Geopark takes you to the traces of the Ice Age Rokua Geopark is the first travel destination in Finland to be awarded UNESCO Global Geopark status. It is one of the northernmost of the almost 200 UNESCO Global Geoparks in the world. Read more about Geopark Right now Summer Rokua Geopark summer experiences There are many ways to enjoy the summer sunshine in Rokua Geopark. Here are some tips for a day trip or a short holiday! Hiking Activities Put on your backpack and go! The hiking trails in Rokua Geopark are set in a unique environment. On your hike, you will experience ridge landscapes with lichens and clear-water ponds, deep river valleys with groves and rocky outcrops, and wide, sun-drenched lake shores. Read more about round trips Mountain biking Activities The most extensive official mountain bike trails in the Rokua Geopark area can be found in Rokua National Park. There are also combined hiking and mountain biking trails in Manamansalo on Lake Oulujärvi and in the Oulujoki Valley Tar Routes. You can bike on your own or take a guided tour. Mountain biking Canoeing Activities A canoe trip is a great way to discover the nature of Rokua Geopark from a different perspective! Canoeing is a form of exercise similar to hiking where you can train your arms and core muscles and refresh your mind with the breathtaking scenery. Canoeing can be done in a kayak or an open canoe. There are a number of companies in the area that can provide canoeing instruction, information and equipment rental. You can contact them to book equipment already when you are planning your trip. Canoeing Fishing Activities The wilderness areas of Rokua Geopark have rich fishing waters. The waters in the area - the Oulujoki River, Lake Oulujäri and a number of smaller lakes and ponds - contain pike, pike-perch, rainbow trout and lake trout. All the waterways in the area have easily accessible and peaceful fishing waters with good accommodation and other facilities for longer fishing trips. Winter fishing is good on the smaller lakes and ponds in the area. Fishing
Memory of the Landscape is a cinematic short film directed by filmmaker Sami Mustonen , who originates from the Rokua UNESCO Global Geopark region in Northern Finland. The film takes the viewer through the landscapes of the Oulujoki River Valley, the Rokua dune area and Lake Oulujärvi, highlighting the region’s Ice Age landscapes, cultural heritage and northern silence. (Show embedded video by allowing cookie settings) Things to do in Rokua Geopark What can you do in Rokua Geopark? Rokua Geopark is a great holiday destination in northern Finland for families, nature lovers and anyone who enjoys a cottage holiday. Or how about a camp school, party or company event in a unique geopark? Rokua for hikers Experience peaceful hiking trails through forests, lakes, and unique Ice Age landscapes in Rokua Geopark. Whether you are looking for a relaxing walk in nature or a longer outdoor adventure, the area offers routes for every season and every pace. Accommodation, restaurants, and nature services are available along the way, making it easy to enjoy the calm atmosphere of Northern Finland. Siirry sivulle Family holiday in Rokua Geopark There's plenty to do in Rokua Geopark with children of all ages! A family holiday in Rokua Geopark offers nature walks, play and insights. Siirry sivulle Cottage holiday in Rokua Geopark Combine your holiday with getting out into the nature on your own feet or with hired equipment. Or swap your kitchen shift for a local restaurant serving delicious local food! Siirry sivulle Rokua Geopark for groups At Rokua Geopark you can organise an event for a large or small group in a rural setting, by a lake, river or next to a national park. Many of the facilities can be combined with accommodation, and there is a programme of activities available in the beautiful Ice Age landscape. Siirry sivulle The fascinating stories of Rokua Geopark Rokua Geopark is home to countless stories The oldest stories tell of the formation of the northern Finnish landscape two billion years ago. More recent ones tell of the experiences, lifestyles and cultural heritage of different generations. The stories open up the history of the area and recount oral and written traditions. Enter a world of fascinating stories! Read stories Products Unforgettable experiences in Rokua Geopark Rokua Geopark offers visitors a lot to see, experience and learn. Browse our services and choose activities for your holiday or day trip! Activities Activities in Rokua Geopark bring you close to nature. Cycling, skiing, biking or hiking in Rokua is an unforgettable experience. The nature in northern Finland makes you relax and calm down. Siirry sivulle Attractions Experience the natural and cultural attractions of Rokua Geopark – from the national park to museums and nature reserves. Siirry sivulle Routes Explore the unique Ice Age landscapes of Rokua Geopark by car or by bike. Scenic routes take you through the peaceful northern Finnish landscapes of the Oulu River Valley, Rokua National Park, and the shores of Lake Oulujärvi, offering geological wonders and authentic outdoor experiences along the way. Siirry sivulle Events Events in the Rokua Geopark area invite visitors to experience peaceful northern nature, local culture, music, and seasonal traditions in the unique landscapes of Northern Finland. Siirry sivulle Services Discover accommodation, restaurants, local services, meeting facilities, and unique experiences in the Rokua Geopark area. Whether you are planning an outdoor adventure, a peaceful holiday, or a nature-inspired getaway in Northern Finland, local services are available throughout the region. Siirry sivulle FAQs Discover why Rokua Geopark is one of Finland’s most unique and peaceful nature destinations. Learn about Northern Lights, snowy winters, hiking trails, Ice Age landscapes, and authentic northern experiences just south of Lapland.
